CEO-led insider cluster bought $9.5M on the open market straight into the crash - strongest bullish signal in this batch - but the fundamental CONFIRMED rating is stale (predates the guidance cut) and the operational crisis is still resolving. Reclassified TURNAROUND, not a standard reversal swing.
